items.exposure: Experimental, off-by-default web policy feature. Impact: client signs a withdraw order that will revert (wrong amount-vs-limit check), wasted signature/gas; contract still enforces.

items.title: M-3: TokenBucketLimiter per-group slot quota and per-group overflow buckets
items.exposure: Optional relayer only (apps/relayer/src/limiter.ts:145 builds TokenBucketLimiter without maxOverflowGroups; maxKeys default 10000, maxPerGroup 1250). Attacker needs >=8 distinct abuse groups (/48 or /24) each holding ~1250 non-idle keys, i.e. ~10k requests inside a few seconds, to make all new honest clients share one overflow bucket (new-client DoS, no fund loss). Not in lean static build.
items.proof: Partly kept: group slot quota exists (limiter.ts maxPerGroup default ceil(maxKeys/8), take() line ~118-135) and groupOf now defaults to groupOfBucketKey. LOST: per-group overflow by default. dd756b08 defaulted maxOverflowGroups=1024 with an overflowTable; today limiter.ts:140 `maxOverflowGroups ?? 0`, so all overflow lands in the single global overflowBucket (limiter.ts take(): `bucket ??= this.overflowBucket`). Dropped in checkpoint ecc29c1e (Oct 22), never restored. Failing assertions: after 64 one-key groups fill an 8-key table, newcomer 'fresh0:x' take().ok expected true got false (repro.3.test.ts:28); with maxKeys 2/maxPerGroup 1, group 'd' newcomer is charged to the global bucket drained by group 'c' (repro.3.test.ts:40). The group slot quota tests pass, so one group alone cannot fill the table.
items.fix_guidance: Restore default maxOverflowGroups (1024, bounded overflow table with idle eviction) in TokenBucketLimiter, keep the global bucket as last resort, and add stats() overflow counter (see item 4).
items.repro_command: cd packages/relayer-guard && npx vitest run src/repro.T-dd756b08.3.test.ts --coverage=false

Log: scratchpad/triage/repro.T-dd756b08.3-4.log

second_check.evidence: Could not refute. ecc29c1e rewrote limiter.ts from the pre-fix parent 35df181b instead of from dd756b08. It keeps the slot quota but sets maxOverflowGroups ?? 0 (limiter.ts:145), so all overflow goes to the one global bucket (:186). Opt-in exists (my scratch test passes with maxOverflowGroups:1024), but its slots are never evicted. No caller opts in: apps/relayer/src/limiter.ts:146-149 and pool-relayer service.ts:108. The repro fails because of the default, not because of a fixture. The dd756b08 spec section 9 and DEVIATIONS item 11 are gone.

items.fix_guidance: Re-add bounded scan of the oldest N entries for an idle one in BoundedTable (both token-bucket and loss tables share it), and stats() {overflowHits, tableSize, overflowGroups} exported with LimiterStats.
